topic: DataCite metadata for citable research outputs
metadata_implication: Use DataCite 4.7-oriented fields for future DOI/citation metadata, but keep identifier and creator fields pending until a real release target exists.
Model the package as a root Dataset with file Data Entities, contextual organizations, and workflow provenance.
Keep README YAML metadata, tags, task category, intended use, limitations, and license state explicit.
Credit NASA OSDR/GeneLab and defer dataset-specific BibTeX/RIS to the OSDR study citation path.
Keep upstream OSDR source identifiers and access boundaries as primary public-source anchors.
